The designer should remove one of them to avoid over-dimensioning.","recommended_correction":"Delete either D15 or D23."},{"rule_id":"MX-006","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"2-⌀15"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"2-⌀8.4"}],"comment":"The patterns of two ⌀15 holes (D5) and two ⌀8.4 holes (D9) have no PCD, spacing, pitch, coordinates, or linear dimensions locating their positions on the part. Without positional information the machinist cannot locate these hole patterns. The designer should add center-to-center spacing or locating dimensions for each pattern.","recommended_correction":"Add linear dimensions or a PCD to fully define the position of the 2-⌀15 and 2-⌀8.4 hole patterns."},{"rule_id":"MD-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"}],"comment":"The drawing carries a tolerance of ±0.02 (D21) and a fit code H7 (D24) but has no datum flags or GD&T frames anywhere. Without datums there is no reference frame to inspect or machine these tight tolerances reliably. The designer should establish appropriate datum features and reference them in the dimensioning scheme.","recommended_correction":"Add datum feature symbols and reference them in the relevant GD&T frames or dimensional tolerances."}]}
